## What would you like to add or change?
A clear description of the component or improvement.

## Which Atomic Design layer does it belong to?
- [ ] Atom
- [ ] Molecule
- [ ] Organism
- [ ] Template
- [ ] Page

## Why is it useful?
Explain the use case — which kinds of apps or screens would benefit from it.

## Proposed API (optional)
If you have a prop interface in mind, share it here.

```tsx
interface MyComponentProps {
  variant?: 'a' | 'b';
  // ...
}
```

## Alternatives considered
Have you looked at existing components that could be extended instead?
